description: Runs the 401k.loans early withdrawal calculator for a cash-out or hardship withdrawal: amount taken out (or the gross needed to net a target), income tax at your marginal rates, the 10% additional tax, what you keep, what the plan withholds up front (20% mandatory, or 10% default for hardship), the check amount, and the balance due or refund at filing.

additional_10pct_tax_applies.description: true if you are under 59.5 and no exception applies, so the 10% additional tax is due. Default true.

federal_bracket_pct.description: 2026 federal income tax bracket in percent (Rev. Proc. 2025-32): 10, 12, 22, 24, 32, 35 or 37.

hardship.description: true for a hardship withdrawal (10% default withholding instead of the 20% that applies to most other withdrawals). Default false.

mode.description: "gross" = amount is what you take out of the plan; "net" = amount is what you need in hand after tax. Default gross.

state_tax_pct.description: State income tax rate in percent, 0 to 15. Default 0.

name: calculate_401k_early_withdrawal
title: 401(k) early withdrawal tax and penalty
